title: private-deploy daily scratchpad - pre-install notes
content:
Quick notes before Monday install (customer: Acme Financial, prod air-gapped VPC + on-prem co-lo)

Purpose:
- capture last-minute environment quirks + explicit install steps to avoid surprises
- checklist for on-site engineer (Riley) and remote SRE support (Miguel)

High-level constraints from customer:
- completely air-gapped: no outbound to internet from management plane -> must use bastion for image pulls
- internal PKI only, no public CAs allowed (we need certs from their internal CA)
- strict egress proxy for telemetry -> telemetry optional for initial install
- NTP provided via internal stratum; must configure nodes to point to 10.10.0.5/10.10.0.6
- KMS/HSM: customer wants HSM-backed key for model keys, we only have KMS integration doc (JIRA-PRJ-4821) -> check compatibility

Pre-install checklist (ordered):
1) Confirm access + creds
   - SSH for on-site engineer -> confirm Riley has jump-host user and sudo (tested 2026-03-07)
   - VPN account for remote SRE (Miguel) -> confirm MFA provisioning done
   - Service account JSON/key for our control-plane connector (will be transferred via secure SFTP by security ops)

2) Networking & DNS
   - VPC subnets: public (bastion) + private (workers). Confirm CIDR mapping matches runbook (10.240.0.0/16 for private).
   - Route tables: private subnets should NOT have internet gateway routes. Verify NAT placement for image proxy (customer-proxy.local:3128)
   - DNS: customer runs internal DNS. We must add redwood-inference.internal A records for control-plane VIPs (ticket created: JIRA-PRJ-4821).

3) Images & package install
   - Because of air-gap, pre-pull images on an intermediate machine that has access to internal registry mirror. Steps:
     a) Build image list from ansible inventory (ansible/roles/images/manifest.yml)
     b) Ask customer to load images into their mirror (they agreed). Confirm SHA tags.
     c) On install day, use local registry creds (provided) to pull to nodes.
   - Verify container runtime (containerd 1.7.x) and kernel reqs (>=5.15).

4) Certificates & secrets
   - Get certs from customer's PKI team (internal CA). We need: control-plane TLS cert (CN=control.redwood.internal), node agent certs, and HSM signing/cert wrappers.
   - KMS integration: check HSM connector compatibility with our kms-agent v0.9. If not compatible, fallback to "customer-managed KMS" flow (manual unseal).

5) Monitoring & telemetry (deferred if needed)
   - Default: disable outgoing telemetry until security signs off. We'll install local logging collector (fluent-bit -> push to customer ELK).

6) Post-install smoke tests
   - API ping to control-plane VIP from within private subnet
   - Run simple inference job (small model) locally and verify latency and model load
   - KV cache warmup + verify token accounting shows no anomalies

Known blockers & gotchas:
- Image digest mismatch: customer mirror sometimes retags images -> always verify image SHA before starting.
- HSM compatibility: customer HSM uses PKCS11 v2 and their vendor module needs extra config on host. Plan: request HSM vendor doc and coordinate with their infra lead (Jonas K.).
- DNS scoping: If control-plane VIP gets different zone, console UI will attempt external lookups -> ensure /etc/hosts entries are provided during install as temporary workaround.
- Time sync: if nodes drift >5s, TLS handshakes fail with HSM-backed keys -> enforce NTP before starting services.

Action items (who/when):
- (Samira) finalize ansible vars for air-gap playbook and push PR to repo: branch samira/airgap-fixes (ETA: today EOD)
- (Riley) confirm bastion accounts + test SSH jump on Monday morning (ETA: 2026-03-09 09:30 local)
- (Miguel) validate HSM connector on lab HSM (use vendor test harness) and report compatibility w/ kms-agent v0.9 (ETA: 2026-03-09)
- (Evelyn) coordinate cert issuance with customer PKI team -> get TLS certs in PEM + chain (ETA: 2026-03-08 end of day)

Notes to self / reminders:
- keep telemetry disabled until security approves persistent connections (we can capture to local disk then transfer manually)
- bring USB with pre-pulled images + digest manifest as contingency for on-site
- add explicit step in runbook to run `ntpdate -u 10.10.0.5` before starting services
- double-check SELinux/AppArmor profiles on their RHEL8 hosts (we need to ensure container runtime allowed syscalls)

Temp commands/snippets (for reference):
- list images: `cat ansible/roles/images/manifest.yml` -> `yq e '.images[] | .name + ":" + .sha' -`
- copy certs to nodes: `scp -o ProxyJump=jump@bastion cert.pem node:/etc/redwood/tls/`
- check containerd version: `containerd --version`

Slack thread references:
- see slack thread in #private-deploy for customer's network diagram (TS:1673041245.000200)

If anything changes, log it here. Will convert to runbook steps and update Confluence after install.

End of scratchpad.
